goal: 通用弹窗/面板背景，用于 LoginPanel、RegisterPanel 等弹窗容器

subject.concept: 毛玻璃风格的半透明深色面板，带有微弱蓝色发光边框
subject.symbolism: 层次感、信息隔离、UI容器，VR界面中的信息承载层

style.border: 1px solid rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.3) 微弱蓝色发光边框
style.inner_detail: 极微弱的对角线渐变增加质感

prompt: A glassmorphism style panel background for VR medical training application UI, a rectangular shape with 16px rounded corners, semi-transparent dark background rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.85), subtle 1px border in translucent cyan blue rgba(0, 180, 216, 0.3) with a soft outer glow effect, the surface has a very faint frosted glass texture with slight diagonal gradient for depth, the overall appearance is a dark translucent glass panel floating over a dark space, 512x512 resolution, the interior is clean and empty ready for UI content, no text, no buttons, no icons, centered composition with even glow on all edges, suitable as a container background for popup panels in VR application
